content:
Long before the iPod, the Sony Walkman was the go-to device for anyone who wanted to soundtrack their life. Now a Duo app is bringing back that experience for those of us who are old enough to have actually owned one, and it'll work with Apple Music…

Before the Walkman, you didn't have a lot of options if you wanted to listen to music on the go. Most cassette players at the time were heavy and bulky. Sony shrunk a recorder originally designed for reporters down to the smallest possible cassette player size, and it quickly became a generation-defining product.

The app was created by developer Vidit Bhargava at a hackathon — where he noticed many attendees had never seen an actual Walkman, so he brought a physical one to show them what it looked like.

You open Duo, pick the album cassette you want to insert, then close the lid and it starts playing.

Bhargava says he originally built the app just for fun as a demo, but will now officially release it as a real app. The best reply on the X post is this — a picture that only people of a certain age will understand.

What was the first music player you ever owned? Share in the comments.
